title: Oppo Launches Enco X4 Wireless Earbuds
excerpt: Oppo introduces the Enco X4 earbuds with lossless audio support, enhanced active noise cancellation, and extended battery life.
body_html:
Oppo has officially introduced its new Enco X4 wireless earbuds to the market. The latest audio device comes equipped with support for lossless audio and features upgraded active noise cancellation technology that delivers twice the performance of previous iterations.

Additionally, the earbuds boast a total battery life of up to 53 hours, providing users with extended usage between charges.
